records.title: Uniform Civil Code Law
details: (c) & (d): The Government of India has referred the proposal to undertake examination of various issues relating to Uniform Civil Code and to make recommendation thereon to 21st Law Commission of India (LCI).

records.title: Honorarium to Anganwadi workers and Helpers

records.title: ROB on NH in Rajasthan
details:
The Ministry has recently sanctioned proposal for Consultancy service
for preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) of Swaroopganj-Kherwara
section of NH-927A including Dungarpur bypass. This inter-alia envisages
bypassing of existing stretch of NH 927A passing through Dungarpur city
including the existing 'Two River bridge'.
